svg.title: Declare Supabase RLS in your Prisma schema
svg.desc: Prisma 8 and Supabase: an ink code card shows a Prisma schema with a supabase:auth.AuthUser relation, @@rls, and a policy_select block; the Prisma prism mark and Supabase logo pair above the headline "RLS lives in your schema". Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand, paper surface with a prism cyan accent.
